```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = "../Figures/mod_SMOTE/")

library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)
library(pROC)
library(yardstick)
library(glmnet)
library(rpart)
```

# Intro

```{r include=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
load("../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_test.Rdata")
glimpse(dat_test)
```

Lo SMOTE NC è stato eseguito in Pyhton con la libreria "imblearn.over_sampling".

```{r include=FALSE}
load("../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_smoothed_k13.Rdata")
glimpse(dat_smoothed)
str(dat_smoothed)

table(dat_smoothed[dat_smoothed$goal_YN==1,"play_pattern"])/sum(dat_smoothed$goal_YN==1)
```

# GLM base

```{r GLM base, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
glm_base <- glm(goal_YN ~ goal_distance + shot_angle_degree, family=binomial, data=dat_smoothed)
summary(glm_base)
exp(coef(glm_base))
prob_glm_base <- predict(glm_base, newdata=dat_test,
                         type="response")
```


# Approccio forward

```{r glm_forward, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
m0 <- glm(goal_YN~1, family=binomial, data=dat_smoothed)
summary(m0)
# Create formula for upper model

upper_formula <- formula(glm(goal_YN~(.), family=binomial, data=dat_smoothed))

# Stepwise selection
m1 <- stepAIC(m0, scope = list(lower = ~ 1, upper = upper_formula), direction = "forward", data = dat_smoothed)

# Summary of the final model
summary(m1)

fitted_test_forward <- predict(m1, newdata=dat_test, type="response")
```

# Ridge

```{r Ridge, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
set.seed(123)
x_matrix <- model.matrix(~., data=dat_smoothed %>% dplyr::select(!goal_YN)) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(!"(Intercept)") %>% as.matrix()

ridge1 <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(
  y=dat_smoothed %>% pull(goal_YN),
  x=x_matrix,
  family="binomial",lambda.min.ratio = 1e-5, nlambda=300, alpha=0,
  maxit = 1e+06, nfolds=10)

plot(ridge1) #grafico tra valore del coefficiente e penalità

ridge1$lambda.min
ridge1$lambda.1se

log(ridge1$lambda.min)
log(ridge1$lambda.1se)

coef(ridge1, s = ridge1$lambda.min)
coef(ridge1, s = ridge1$lambda.1se)

x_matrix_test <- model.matrix(~.,dat_test%>% dplyr::select(!goal_YN)) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(!"(Intercept)") %>% as.matrix()

prob_ridge1_test <- predict(ridge1,
        newx = x_matrix_test,
        s = ridge1$lambda.min)
prob_ridge2_test <- predict(ridge1,
                    newx = x_matrix_test,
                    s = ridge1$lambda.1se)
```


# Lasso

```{r Lasso, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
set.seed(123)
lasso1 <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(
  y=dat_smoothed %>% pull(goal_YN),
  x=x_matrix,
  family="binomial",lambda.min.ratio = 1e-5, nlambda=300,
  alpha=1, maxit = 1e+07, nfolds=10)

plot(lasso1, ylab="Devianza") #grafico tra valore del coefficiente e penalità

lasso1$lambda.min
lasso1$lambda.1se

log(lasso1$lambda.min)
log(lasso1$lambda.1se)

coef(lasso1, s = lasso1$lambda.min)
coef(lasso1, s = lasso1$lambda.1se)

prob_lasso1_test <- predict(lasso1,
        newx = x_matrix_test,
        s = lasso1$lambda.min)
prob_lasso2_test <- predict(lasso1,
                    newx = x_matrix_test,
                    s = lasso1$lambda.1se)
```

## Grouped lasso

```{r G-Lasso, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(grpreg)
grps <- c(rep(1,8), rep(2,3), 3, rep(4,6), rep(5,3), 6, rep(7,2), 8, 9)
length(grps)
ncol(x_matrix)
set.seed(123)
group_lasso <- grpreg::cv.grpreg(
      x_matrix,
      dat_smoothed %>% pull(goal_YN) %>% as.numeric - 1,
      group=grps, penalty="grLasso",
      family="binomial", nfolds=10,
      nlambda=300, alpha=1)

# Plotting the cross-validation results
plot(group_lasso, ylab="Devianza")

best_lambda <- group_lasso$lambda.min
best_lambda
best_lambda_1se <- group_lasso$lambda.1se
best_lambda_1se

coef(group_lasso, s = best_lambda)
coef(group_lasso, s = best_lambda_1se)

prob_group_lasso_test <- predict(group_lasso, X = x_matrix_test, s = best_lambda, type="response")
prob_group_lasso_test_1se <- predict(group_lasso, X = x_matrix_test, s = best_lambda_1se, type="response")
```

# CART

```{r CART}
set.seed(456)
t0 <- rpart(goal_YN ~ ., data = dat_smoothed,
            method = "class",
            parms = list(split="gini"),
            control = rpart.control(minbucket = 5, cp = 0, xval=10))

set.seed(456)
t1 <- rpart(goal_YN ~ ., data = dat_smoothed,
            method = "class",
            parms = list(split="information"),
            control = rpart.control(minbucket = 5, cp = 0, xval=10))

plotcp(t0, main="t0")
plotcp(t1, main="t1")

t0_rowmin <- t0$cptable[,"xerror"] %>% which.min()
t0$cptable[t0_rowmin,"CP"]
t1_rowmin <- t1$cptable[,"xerror"] %>% which.min()
t1$cptable[t1_rowmin,"CP"]

t0_pruned <- prune(t0, cp=t0$cptable[t0_rowmin,"CP"])
t1_pruned <- prune(t1, cp=t1$cptable[t1_rowmin,"CP"])

clrs <- data.frame(n = colnames(dat_test %>%
                          dplyr::select(!goal_YN))) %>% 
  mutate(clrss = scales::hue_pal()(n()))
df <- data.frame(vi = t0_pruned$variable.importance,
                 n = names(t0_pruned$variable.importance))
df <- left_join(x=df, y=clrs, by=join_by(n))
df <- df %>%
  mutate(n = recode(n, "goal_distance"="Distanza dalla porta",
                    "shot_angle_degree"="Angolo di tiro",
                   "play_pattern"="Azione precedente",
                   "shot_type"="Contesto del tiro",
                   "shot_body_part"="Parte del corpo",
                   "shot_technique"="Tecnica di tiro",
                   "home"="Casa",
                   "shot_first_time"="Tiro di prima",
                   "under_pressure"="Sotto pressione"))

df <- df %>%
  arrange(desc(vi)) %>%
  mutate(n = factor(n, levels = n))
ggplot(df) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = vi, x = n, fill=n), stat = "identity") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "Variabile", y = "Importanza", fill = "Nome della variabile") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = df$clrss, labels = df$n)

df <- data.frame(vi = t1_pruned$variable.importance,
                 n = names(t1_pruned$variable.importance))
df <- left_join(x=df, y=clrs, by=join_by(n))
df <- df %>%
  mutate(n = recode(n, "goal_distance"="Distanza dalla porta",
                    "shot_angle_degree"="Angolo di tiro",
                   "play_pattern"="Azione precedente",
                   "shot_type"="Contesto del tiro",
                   "shot_body_part"="Parte del corpo",
                   "shot_technique"="Tecnica di tiro",
                   "home"="Casa",
                   "shot_first_time"="Tiro di prima",
                   "under_pressure"="Sotto pressione"))

# Sort the data frame by the vi column
df <- df %>%
  arrange(desc(vi)) %>%
  mutate(n = factor(n, levels = n))
ggplot(df) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = vi, x = n, fill=n), stat = "identity") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "Variabile", y = "Importanza", fill = "Nome della variabile") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = df$clrss, labels = df$n)

glimpse(dat_test)
t0_predict <- predict(t0, dat_test)[,2]
t0p_predict <- predict(t0_pruned, dat_test)[,2]
t1_predict <- predict(t1, dat_test)[,2]
t1p_predict <- predict(t1_pruned, dat_test)[,2]
```

# Valutazione: curva roc

```{r Valutazione, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
prediction <- tibble(truth = as.factor(dat_test$goal_YN), pred=as.numeric(fitted_test_forward),
                     model="GLM forward") %>%
              
              add_row( truth=as.factor(dat_test$goal_YN),
              model="GLM base",
              pred=as.numeric(prob_glm_base)) %>%
              
              add_row( truth=as.factor(dat_test$goal_YN),
              model="Ridge",
              pred=as.numeric(ridge1_fitted)) %>%
              
              add_row( truth=as.factor(dat_test$goal_YN),
              model="Lasso1",
              pred=as.numeric(lasso1_fitted1)) %>%
              
              add_row( truth=as.factor(dat_test$goal_YN),
              model="Lasso2",
              pred=as.numeric(lasso1_fitted2)) %>%
  
  add_row(truth = as.factor(dat_test$goal_YN), pred=as.numeric(t0_predict), model="Albero gini") %>%
  
  add_row(truth = as.factor(dat_test$goal_YN), pred=as.numeric(t0p_predict), model="Tree gini (pruned)") %>%
  
  add_row(truth = as.factor(dat_test$goal_YN), pred=as.numeric(t1_predict), model="Tree entropy") %>%
  
  add_row(truth = as.factor(dat_test$goal_YN), pred=as.numeric(t1p_predict), model="Albero entropy (pruned)")

# Compute the ROC curves for each model
roc_data <- prediction %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, pred, event_level = "second")

auc_values <- prediction %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  yardstick::roc_auc(truth, pred, event_level = "second") %>%
  mutate(label_y = seq(0.01, 0.3, length.out = n())) %>%
  dplyr::select(!.estimator) %>% 
  rename(auc=.estimate)

# Merge the AUC values back into the ROC data for plotting
roc_data <- roc_data %>%
  left_join(auc_values, by = "model")

# Plot ROC curves with AUC annotations
ggplot(roc_data, aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity, color = model)) +
  geom_path(size = 1.2) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Curva ROC",
    x = "1 - Specificità",
    y = "Sensitività",
    color = "Model"
  ) +
  # Add AUC annotations
  geom_text(
    data = auc_values,
    aes(label = paste0("AUC = ", round(auc, 3)), y = label_y),
    x = 0.8,
    size = 4,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
coord_fixed()
```
Vedo che in entrambi i casi il modello ha previsto quasi esclusivamente 0, ossia non goal. Questo è dovuto anche alla grande presenza di 0 nel training set (90%).

# matrici di confusione

```{r Tabelle, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
cm_and_fscore <- function(probs){
  
  library(pROC)
  my_roc <- roc(dat_test$goal_YN, probs)
  auc <- pROC::auc(my_roc)
  cat("AUC:", auc, "\n\n")
  threshold <- coords(my_roc, "best", ret = "threshold",
         best.method="closest.topleft", best.weights=c(1,mean(dat_test$goal_YN==1))) %>% as.numeric()
  cat("Soglia:", threshold, "\n\n")
  
  cat("\n-------------------------")
  Fitted_goal <-  ifelse(probs >= threshold, 1, 0)
  
  f_score <- tibble(t=as.factor(dat_test$goal_YN),
       e=factor(Fitted_goal, levels=c(0,1))) %>% f_meas(truth=t,
                  estimate=e, event_level = "second") %>% dplyr::select(.estimate) %>% as.numeric()
  cat("f-score:", f_score, "\n\n")
  
  caret::confusionMatrix(data=as.factor(Fitted_goal), reference=as.factor(dat_test$goal_YN))
}

cm_and_fscore(prob_glm_base)
cm_and_fscore(fitted_test_forward)
cm_and_fscore(prob_ridge1_test)
cm_and_fscore(prob_ridge2_test)
cm_and_fscore(prob_lasso1_test)
cm_and_fscore(prob_lasso2_test)
cm_and_fscore(prob_group_lasso_test)
cm_and_fscore(prob_group_lasso_test_1se)
cm_and_fscore(prob_group_lasso_test)
cm_and_fscore(prob_group_lasso_test_1se)
cm_and_fscore(t0_predict)
cm_and_fscore(t0p_predict)
cm_and_fscore(t1_predict)
cm_and_fscore(t1p_predict)
```
